_meta.description: 8 lunar phases with rituals, crystals, tarot cards, affirmations, and spiritual guidance

description.en: The New Moon marks the beginning of the lunar cycle. The Moon aligns with the Sun, making it invisible from Earth. This is a powerful time for new beginnings, setting intentions, and planting seeds for the month ahead.
description.ko: 신월은 달력 주기의 시작을 나타냅니다. 달이 태양과 일치하여 지구에서 보이지 않습니다. 새로운 시작, 의도 설정, 앞으로의 달을 위한 씨앗 심기를 위한 강력한 시간입니다.

new_moon.what_to_do_en: Set clear intentions. Write down 3 things you want to manifest. Rest and reflect. Avoid major confrontations.
new_moon.what_to_avoid_en: Rushing into decisions; burning energy on completion rather than new starts
new_moon.crystals_purpose_en: Labradorite for intuition; Moonstone for new beginnings; Black Tourmaline and Obsidian for clearing negative energy
tarot_cards: Ace cards (Ace of Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles)
new_moon.affirmation_en: I plant seeds of intention with clarity and trust. New beginnings flow to me naturally.
new_moon.affirmation_ko: 나는 명확함과 신뢰로 의도의 씨앗을 심습니다. 새로운 시작이 자연스럽게 내게 흘러옵니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What do I wish to create this month?
What old patterns am I ready to release?
What is my deepest intention right now?
new_moon.astro_connection: Each new moon occurs in the zodiac sign the sun is in — amplifying that sign's themes

description.en: A thin sliver of the Moon becomes visible as it begins its growth phase. This is a time of momentum, hope, and taking the first steps toward your intentions. The energy is gaining — move forward with confidence.
description.ko: 달의 성장 단계가 시작되면서 가느다란 초승달이 보입니다. 이것은 모멘텀, 희망, 그리고 의도를 향한 첫 발을 내딛는 시간입니다.

recommended_rituals_en: Take first steps on new projects
Make one phone call or email you've been postponing
waxing_crescent.what_to_do_en: Take small but meaningful actions toward your intention. Keep momentum. Express gratitude for progress.
waxing_crescent.crystals_purpose_en: Citrine for manifestation; Carnelian for courage and action; Green Aventurine for luck and opportunity
waxing_crescent.affirmation_en: I take bold steps forward and embrace the unfolding of my dreams.
waxing_crescent.affirmation_ko: 나는 담대하게 앞으로 나아가고 꿈의 펼쳐짐을 받아들입니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What one action can I take today toward my intention?
Where do I feel fear, and can I move through it?
Who can support me on this journey?

description.en: Exactly half the Moon is illuminated. This is a decision point — challenges arise and you must choose to push forward or reassess. The energy is one of tension and determination. Act despite obstacles.
description.ko: 달의 정확히 절반이 빛납니다. 이것은 결정의 시점입니다 — 도전이 생기고 앞으로 나아갈지 재평가할지 선택해야 합니다. 에너지는 긴장과 결단력입니다.

first_quarter.what_to_do_en: Face challenges directly. Make decisions you've been postponing. Assert your needs with confidence.
first_quarter.crystals_purpose_en: Tiger's Eye for courage and clarity; Bloodstone for endurance; Red Jasper for grounding strength
first_quarter.affirmation_en: I face challenges with courage and make decisions from my highest wisdom.
first_quarter.affirmation_ko: 나는 용기로 도전에 맞서고 내 최고의 지혜에서 결정을 내립니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What obstacles am I facing, and what is the lesson in them?
What decision have I been avoiding?
Where do I need to assert my boundaries?

description.en: The Moon is nearly full and energy is building to a peak. This is a time for refinement, adjustment, and preparing for culmination. Review your progress and fine-tune. Gratitude and patience are key.
description.ko: 달이 거의 보름에 가깝고 에너지가 최고조에 달하고 있습니다. 이것은 정제, 조정, 정점을 위한 준비의 시간입니다.

recommended_rituals_en: Rest and prepare for the full moon
waxing_gibbous.what_to_do_en: Review what you started at the new moon. Adjust course as needed. Express gratitude. Prepare ritually for the full moon.
waxing_gibbous.what_to_avoid_en: Forcing outcomes, impatience, abandoning what you've started
waxing_gibbous.crystals_purpose_en: Clear Quartz to amplify energy; Selenite to cleanse; Amazonite for truth and hope
waxing_gibbous.affirmation_en: I trust the process and refine my path with patience and gratitude.
waxing_gibbous.affirmation_ko: 나는 과정을 신뢰하며 인내와 감사로 나의 길을 다듬습니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What is working well that I can be grateful for?
What needs adjustment before completion?
Am I aligned with my original intention?

description.en: The Moon is fully illuminated in opposition to the Sun. Emotions, intuition, and energy peak. Whatever you've been working toward becomes visible — results appear, emotions intensify, and psychic sensitivity heightens. A powerful time for gratitude, release, and celebration.
description.ko: 달이 태양과 반대편에서 완전히 빛납니다. 감정, 직관, 에너지가 최고조에 달합니다. 노력해 온 것들이 가시화되고, 감정이 격화되며, 영적 민감성이 높아집니다.

recommended_rituals_en: Full moon charging of crystals under moonlight
Release ceremony — burn or bury what no longer serves
full_moon.what_to_do_en: Celebrate achievements. Release what no longer serves you. Charge your crystals. Be extra gentle with intense emotions.
full_moon.what_to_avoid_en: Major new beginnings (better at New Moon); rash decisions from peak emotional state
full_moon.crystals_purpose_en: Moonstone for divine feminine; Selenite for cleansing; Clear Quartz for amplification; Labradorite for mystery and intuition
full_moon.affirmation_en: I am grateful for all that has manifested. I release what no longer serves my highest good.
full_moon.affirmation_ko: 나는 현현된 모든 것에 감사합니다. 나의 최고선을 더 이상 섬기지 않는 것을 놓아 보냅니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What has come to fruition since the new moon?
What emotions are surfacing and what do they reveal?
What am I ready to release — habits, people, beliefs?
full_moon.special_notes_en: Super Full Moons (closer to Earth) amplify energy further. Full moons in each zodiac sign take on that sign's archetypal themes.

description.en: The Moon begins to wane after fullness. This is a time to share the wisdom and insights gained from the full moon phase. Give back to your community. Teach what you've learned.
description.ko: 달이 보름 이후 기울기 시작합니다. 이것은 보름달 단계에서 얻은 지혜와 통찰을 나누는 시간입니다.

waning_gibbous.what_to_do_en: Share, teach, and give gratitude. Integrate the lessons of the full moon. Give back to your community.
waning_gibbous.what_to_avoid_en: Hoarding insights; dwelling in peak emotions rather than releasing them
waning_gibbous.crystals_purpose_en: Sunstone for optimism and joy; Amber for warmth and sharing; Yellow Calcite for integration
waning_gibbous.affirmation_en: I share my gifts freely and give thanks for all I've received.
waning_gibbous.affirmation_ko: 나는 내 선물을 자유롭게 나누고 내가 받은 모든 것에 감사합니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What have I learned this lunar cycle?
How can I share my insights with others?
Who deserves my gratitude?

description.en: The left half of the Moon is illuminated in the Northern Hemisphere. This is a powerful time for release, forgiveness, and letting go. Clear out what is not working. Make space for the new moon cycle to come.
description.ko: 북반구에서 달의 왼쪽 절반이 빛납니다. 이것은 해방, 용서, 놓아 보냄을 위한 강력한 시간입니다.

recommended_rituals_en: End relationships or projects that aren't working
last_quarter.what_to_do_en: Release grudges and resentments. Declutter your space. Forgive yourself and others. Prepare for renewal.
last_quarter.what_to_avoid_en: Starting new major projects; holding onto what is completed
last_quarter.crystals_purpose_en: Black Tourmaline for protection and release; Smoky Quartz for transmuting negative energy; Apache Tears for grief and healing
last_quarter.affirmation_en: I release all that no longer serves me and make space for new blessings.
last_quarter.affirmation_ko: 나는 더 이상 나를 섬기지 않는 모든 것을 놓아 보내고 새로운 축복을 위한 공간을 만듭니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What am I finally ready to release?
Who or what needs my forgiveness?
What habits or patterns have run their course?

description.en: A thin sliver of Moon remains before the new moon. This is the darkest, quietest phase — a time for rest, deep inner reflection, and surrender. Let go completely and prepare for rebirth in the new moon cycle.
description.ko: 신월 이전에 가느다란 달만 남습니다. 이것은 가장 어둡고 조용한 단계로 — 휴식, 깊은 내면 성찰, 항복의 시간입니다.

waning_crescent.what_to_do_en: Rest deeply. Dream. Meditate. Spend time alone. Trust that everything is preparing for the next cycle. Listen to your body.
waning_crescent.what_to_avoid_en: Overextending yourself; forcing productivity; social obligations that drain energy
waning_crescent.crystals_purpose_en: Amethyst for spiritual connection; Lepidolite for peace and rest; Moonstone for dreamwork and intuition
waning_crescent.affirmation_en: I rest in surrender and trust in the wisdom of the cycles.
waning_crescent.affirmation_ko: 나는 항복 속에서 쉬고 순환의 지혜를 신뢰합니다.
journaling_prompts_en: What does my body and soul need to rest?
What wisdom has this cycle revealed to me?
What do I want to create in the next new moon?
waning_crescent.dream_guidance_en: Dreams during the Balsamic Moon are especially prophetic. Keep a dream journal on your bedside table.

lunar_cycle_overview.description_en: A complete lunar cycle takes approximately 29.5 days (synodic month). The Moon cycles through 8 phases, each with distinct energy and spiritual significance.
lunar_cycle_overview.cycle_metaphor_en: The lunar cycle mirrors the natural rhythm of creation: intention (new) → growth (crescent, first quarter, gibbous) → peak (full) → release (waning gibbous, last quarter, balsamic) → renewal (new moon again).
lunar_cycle_overview.cycle_metaphor_ko: 달의 주기는 창조의 자연적 리듬을 반영합니다: 의도(신월) → 성장(초승달, 상현달, 상현 이후) → 절정(보름달) → 해방(하현 이후, 하현달, 그믐달) → 새로운 시작(다시 신월).

moon_in_zodiac.description_en: The Moon transits through each zodiac sign for approximately 2.5 days, coloring the energy of each phase.

sign_themes.cancer: Deep emotion, home, nurturing (Moon's home sign)

moon_water_ritual.how_to_en: Place a glass jar of water outside or on a windowsill under the full moon overnight. In the morning, collect it and use for drinking, anointing, watering plants, or adding to baths.

crystal_charging.how_to_en: Place crystals on a window sill or outdoors under the moon for 4-8 hours. The full moon's energy is strongest for charging and cleansing.
